response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), ranked AS (SELECT order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM ranked WHERE share > average_share
